serverInfo.title: livedot MCP
serverInfo.description: Where someone is right now in a live running or cycling race, with a live map; running and cycling clubs near you; coaches and training groups near you; race-day weather and course flyovers; charity teams' events and live maps, and where to give (livedot for Good); known trek and mountain routes and AdventureLive trips; and help with the apps. Windline for cycling, RunFast for running. Free.
